name: BelarusianGLUE
description: BelarusianGLUE is a natural language understanding benchmark for the Belarusian language, comprising approximately 15,000 instances across five tasks including sentiment analysis, linguistic acceptability, word in context, Winograd schema challenge, and textual entailment. It evaluates model performance on a lower-resourced East Slavic language and highlights task-specific model strengths and weaknesses.
typical_sota_score: 70–90% (varies by task; lower-resource tasks may report lower values)
reputation: A newly introduced low-resource language benchmark that is useful for Belarusian NLU research but is not yet a widely established standard like GLUE or XNLI.
notes: Released datasets and evaluation code publicly; reveals significant gaps on harder tasks like Winograd schema challenge.
